questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD said messenger after messenger would announce news to the king of Babylon. What was the news?

answers.text: His city has been captured from end to end
His army has won the battle at the walls
His enemies have turned around and gone home

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, what did the LORD say He would make of the land of Babylon?

answers.text: A province ruled by the Medes
A city of refuge for nations

questions.question: After Jerusalem cried out about the violence Babylon had done to her, what did the LORD say He would do for her?

answers.text: Plead her case and take vengeance for her
Leave her case for the nations to settle
Tell her to make peace with Babylon

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD said He would serve Babylon's people a feast and make them drunk. What would happen after that?

answers.text: They would fall asleep and never wake up
They would wake up and turn back to God
They would march out to fight the Medes
